ideas.title: The Impact of Childcare Fraud on Minnesota Families
ideas.description: An investigation into how childcare fraud affects families in Minnesota, including potential solutions and actions being taken by authorities.
ideas.angle: The human impact of fraud on families and potential solutions
questions: How does childcare fraud affect Minnesota families?
What actions are being taken to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the personal stories of families affected by childcare fraud and the efforts of authorities to combat it.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Scale of Corruption within the Minnesota Democratic Party
ideas.description: An in-depth look at the allegations of corruption within the Minnesota Democratic Party, including potential misuse of donations and the implications for Gov. Tim Walz.
ideas.angle: The extent of corruption and its implications for the party and Gov. Walz
questions: What is the scale of corruption within the Minnesota Democratic Party?
How does this impact Gov. Tim Walz?
ideas.insight: This story could provide a detailed analysis of the allegations and their potential impact on the party and Gov. Walz.
